actions.title: Prepare an IRB submission
actions.summary: Describe your study in your own words. Metis asks what the committee needs to know, drafts the cover letter on the institute's template, and lists the documents to enclose.
actions.ask: Help me prepare an ITM IRB submission for my study. Here is what I want to do:
produces: Open questions to settle before submitting

actions.title: Make an ITM presentation
actions.summary: Give the topic, the audience and the length. Metis builds the deck on the institute's template.
produces: PowerPoint deck in the institute's style

actions.title: Make an ITM poster
actions.summary: Give the abstract or the main findings. Metis lays them out on the institute's portrait poster.
actions.ask: Make an ITM poster from this abstract:
produces: Portrait poster (.pptx) in the institute's style

missing_templates: Participant information sheet and informed consent form

focus.title: ITM
focus.subtitle: The institute's actions, one click away
focus.overview: Everything that belongs to the institute rather than to one project: the IRB route, the institute's presentation and poster templates, and the institute in the news. The full list is on the ITM surface.
